title: Small Changes, Big Trouble: Demystifying and Parsing License Variants for Incompatibility Detection in the PyPI Ecosystem
summary: The original pipeline studies license variants in PyPI, parses license terms with LV-Parser using diff-based analysis, standard-license knowledge, similar examples, and LLM prompting, then uses LV-Compat to detect dependency license incompatibilities.
This reproduction replaces the full LV-Parser workflow with a simplified single-LLM prompt that directly parses each license text into the paper's license-term schema.
